title: Agent distillation trace step
description: One JSONL line. Required fields match RFC-0001 / issue #1.

episode_id.description: Optional grouping key for one explore run.

task_family.description: Optional family key used by the store, e.g. close_ticket.

action.description: Human-readable action label; often equals tool.

tool.description: Tool / API name. Null for no-op or finish.

success.description: Whether this step's tool call succeeded, not whether the task is done.
